name: phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding
rationale: Whole-protein ISS from a paralog; the PI3P-binding PX domain (PF00787) is absent from Nvj3; no PX-like region detected by Foldseek; no direct assay

name: lipid binding
rationale: Predicted conserved hydrophobic conduit in the Nvj3 monomer; supported by AlphaFold cavity metrics and character-level conservation, but no ligand identified and no binding assay exists for Nvj3

name: lipid transfer activity
rationale: Transfer requires demonstrated extraction and delivery between bilayers. Only predicted tunnel geometry and loss-of-function lipid phenotypes exist; adding this now would repeat the over-annotation pattern seen with GO:0032266

name: lipid metabolic process
rationale: Supported by nvj3 loss-of-function lipid phenotypes. PMID:41542480 (preprint) would support a more specific term such as triglyceride biosynthetic process or lipid droplet organization once peer reviewed
